full_judgment: 3. The learned Sessions Judge has based his reasons for his recommendation on a decision of the Dacca High Court in the case of Rebati Mohan Sarkar, Vs. Ansar Ali Mondal and others, reported in 5 D L.R. 162D. In this decision a Division Bench of the Dacca High Court has laid down that the life of the proceedings under section 144 of the Code expires after two months and after that time a fresh proceeding under section 145 of the Code would thereafter be started because proceedings under section 144 being irretrievably dead they could not either be revived or converted into anything else. In that decision proceeding under section 144 Cr.P.C. was started on the 4th of October, 1950 and subsequently on the 4th of January 1951 the learned Magistrate made an order drawing proceeding under section 145 of the Code.
